rationale: The bearish structure that justified the short is still intact — price at $21.14 remains below session VWAP ($21.31) and the 9-EMA ($21.19), sits in the bottom 13% of today's range, and $21.05 support held only after tagging $21.01, with relative volume still elevated at 3.18x. The recent bounce off the low is modest chop within an unbroken downtrend and the $21.30 invalidation is untouched, so neither the original thesis nor a genuine bullish reversal (which would be required to flip) is established; holding keeps the ~1.5:1 reward-to-risk toward $20.90 alive while the tight $21.30 stop caps further damage.
